Hi Sophie —

A couple of quick clarifications before the Wed sync so we can make the meeting efficient:
1) Scope: please confirm whether Emberlane wants the full SIG questionnaire (standard scope) or just the CAIQ subset focused on data residency and encryption. If you could mark "full" or "subset" in the spreadsheet, that helps.
2) Evidence owners: for anything related to production logs, infra config, or logging retention, we'll own the artifacts. For policy documents (e.g., access control, incident response runbooks), please assign an Emberlane owner who can upload finalized PDFs.
3) Recording / redaction: Redwood is happy to record for internal reference. We will not store raw recordings beyond 30 days unless you request longer retention. If Emberlane requires a signed consent form, Marissa — can you send the DocuSign link?

Prep items I'm bringing to the call:
- Redacted log samples (sanitized)
- Description of our KV caching and tokenization boundaries (brief)
- Mapping of what we do in-hosted vs. dedicated/private deployments

If the Wed 14:00 slot is confirmed, I'll make sure the infra engineer can join the last 20 minutes for questions.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
